endorsements.name: Amr Al Hallak
endorsements.label: CVE-2022-45049
endorsements.description: A reflected XSS vulnerability has been found in Axiell Iguana CMS, allowing an attacker to execute code in a victim's browser. The url parameter on the novelist.php endpoint does not properly neutralise user input, resulting in the vulnerability.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.1, 6.1)
